page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9gc.64xlarge is an x86_64 server instance within the compute-optimized with GPU family, virtualized via KVM. The hardware configuration features 256 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors operating at a nominal clock frequency of 3.3 GHz. System memory totals 1536.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory allocation density of 6.0 GB per vCPU core.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by eight NVIDIA Blackwell architecture GPUs delivering an aggregate total of 576 GB of VRAM. High-throughput network communication is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 380 Gbps, accommodating high-volume inter-node data exchange.

Storage requires network-attached volumes, as the instance includes no local storage out of the box. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dense allocation of dedicated AMD compute cores, Blackwell accelerators, and large memory pool aligns resource efficiency toward large-scale machine learning training, large language model inference pipelines, and distributed data processing workloads requiring substantial GPU memory footprints.
